name: v1.9.0 — Standalone public dashboard
body:
## Highlights

- Standalone, local and read-only dashboard maintained by Asseris.
- Claude JSONL, compatible request NDJSON, Cache-Fix and MeterRow v1 adapters.
- Cost Forensic, multilingual setup and configurable page templates.
- Version checks, tests and release mirroring.
